title: Gate creature statline parentheticals, formulas, XP, and conditionals
description:
Finding source:
- Fable found dropped AC parentheticals, HP formulas, CR-0 XP ambiguity, form-specific speeds/AC, and hover semantics.
- Existing gates were green because the fields were never expected by the model.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add source-vs-model creature statline gate covering AC source/variants, HP formula, CR/XP, speed variants, and hover.
- Gate must fail on the exact loss categories Fable quantified: 206 AC parentheticals, 316 HP formulas, CR-0 10 XP cases, lycanthrope form stats, Mage/Druid/Ankheg conditionals.

Dependency note:
- Blocked by the statline modeling beads and the CR-0 XP bead: the gate can only pass once the model carries the data.
close_reason: Covered by PR #394 (eshyra-o9bd.18.6.4): the creature-statline-fidelity srdAudit gate enforces AC parentheticals/conditionals/variants via residue-vs-sourceText matching, HP formula presence + floored-mean math, hover, and form-specific speed variants via exact Speed-line re-render; CR/XP is enforced by the creature-cr-xp gate (18.9.3, printed Challenge line). All quantified loss categories (206 AC parentheticals, 316 HP formulas, CR-0 XP, lycanthrope form stats, Mage/Druid/Ankheg conditionals) now fail closed. The parser additionally fails closed on statline grammar, so an independent coordinate-level oracle adds no marginal coverage; the deep-audit tooling bead (18.9.1) supplies the independent source-side verification.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: PR #394 (eshyra-o9bd.18.6.4) added the creature-statline-fidelity srdAudit gate covering AC parentheticals/conditionals (sourceText residue check), HP formulas (grammar + floored-mean math), hover, and form-specific speeds (exact re-render vs speedSourceText). XP is already gated by creature-cr-xp (18.9.3). This bead's scope appears substantially covered — review whether anything remains (e.g. an independent coordinate-level oracle) or close as done-by-18.6.4.
